description: This file defines a helper utility class 'Log' for simplified logging operations, providing static methods for different log levels and chaining log nodes in an Android environment.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels, interfacing with LogNode chains, and acting as a replacement for Android's default Log class.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion failure message, optionally with an exception.
